maintenance_led.reason: Sells Quest, Atkins and OWYN packaged snacks, bars and shakes, which are consumables used up, not repairs or maintenance.

publicly_funded.reason: Consumers buy Quest and Atkins snacks through grocery, club, mass and e-commerce retailers; no government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through brand sales and new products like Quest chips; Atkins and OWYN were occasional, selective acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Consumer snack bars and shakes are easily swapped for competing brands at retail; no switching cost.
